facts.fact: Trade and Development Bank (TDB, a development bank) committed US$50 million in 2022 to Cable & Wireless Seychelles, a private telecom operator, to refinance debt (about US$48.1 million per its 2023 report) and fund digital transformation, including a US$5 million convertible note; the year is from the document's published date.
facts.system: CWS debt refinancing and digital transformation facility
